sources.title: Qwen3-0.6B: Lightweight Open-Source LLM with Thinking Mode
sources.snippet: Qwen3-0.6B is a 0.6B-parameter causal language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, designed for efficient deployment on resource-constrained devices. It uniquely supports dynamic switching between 'thinking mode' (enhanced reasoning for math/coding) and 'non-thinking mode' (fast, general-purpose dialogue) within a single model.
